name: dsh

integrity.lockfile: package-lock.json beside this file: 725 entries (654 packages installed on linux-x64), each by integrity hash; npm ci refuses a tarball whose hash differs
integrity.checked: at image build: npm ci against the lockfile, then dsh --version must print 0.2.2-rc.1; the adapter compares dsh --version with this file's version before anything else and exits 2 on a difference

release_status: developer preview: npm dist-tag latest is 0.2.2-rc.1 (published 2026-11-04), and the upstream README warns of compatibility-breaking changes, so any re-pin is a new run
install: npm ci in /opt/harness on node:24-bookworm-slim with --allow-scripts=@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local,koffi,node-pty (dsh's engines field asks for node >= 24.9.0)
serve_turn_command: dsh --profile headless --patch /opt/harness/config/patch.yml --json --permission-mode danger-full-access [--session-id <id>] - < <log>/turns/turn-NNNN.prompt.md, under setsid with the adapter's own wall clock (budget, then SIGTERM to the session and SIGKILL 5 s later)

model.model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (the adapter's default; every cell sets HE_MODEL_NAME and config/patch.yml's agent-default-model follows it)
model.api: anthropic-messages through dsh's pi-ai adapter (@anthropic-ai/sdk 0.129.0): POST <base>/v1/messages, streamed
model.api_key_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (set from HE_MODEL_API_KEY), named by providers.anthropic.apiKeyEnv
model.routes_registered: anthropic only; dsh's DeepSeek routes (llm-deepseek, llm-deepseek-account) stay mounted with no key, and the headless profile disables the account route
model.max_tokens: 128000 on agent requests for claude-opus-5-5 (observed against a fake endpoint); 4096 on the session-title request
model.thinking: {type: adaptive, display: summarized} by default (observed); not changed
model.side_requests: one session-title request per new Session (dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm, no tools, max_tokens 4096) on the cell model; kept as dsh ships it
model.retries: retryPolicy {mode: normal, maxRetries: 2} on the anthropic route instead of dsh's 5 (observed: a 500 was tried 6 times over 18 s by default, 3 times in 3 s with the setting; a closed port ends in 3 s with code TRANSPORT)

mcp_config_path: config/patch.yml inserts one @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client row per server (he-mcp-world, he-mcp-gbrain): transport streamable-http, url and Authorization: Bearer <token> from HE_WORLD_MCP_URL/TOKEN (HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL/TOKEN), failOnStartupError true; a row whose URL is unset is disabled. Tools register as mcp__world__<tool> and mcp__gbrain__<tool>
multi_user_mode: CLI, one dsh Session per conversation in one DSH_HOME; no daemon

serve.session_key: dm:<member> | channel:<id>; :t<thread_ts> appended when TurnRequest.thread_ts is set
serve.session_id: dsh makes the Session id (session-<uuid>) on a key's first turn; the adapter reads it from the session event and keeps key -> id in /harness-state/dsh-sessions.json; later turns pass --session-id <id>, which adopts that persisted Session
serve.exit_mapping: HE_MODEL_BASE_URL not ending in /anthropic -> 2 at startup; turn outlived its budget -> 124; no session or final event (a crash, an MCP server that failed at startup) -> 2; a configured MCP server's tool call whose error result starts with a transport failure -> 2; final reason error whose message starts with an HTTP status or whose code is TRANSPORT -> 3; any other error reason or a non-zero dsh exit -> 2; else 0. SIGTERM during a turn -> 2

mcp_checks: before ready the adapter POSTs a JSON-RPC tools/list with the bearer to each configured server (up to 5 attempts) and exits 2 if one does not answer; failOnStartupError true makes dsh itself stop before its first model request when a server cannot be reached
deviations: --permission-mode danger-full-access: the shipped preset with no sandbox and approval never, since no approval can be answered in a headless turn; the container is the sandbox, as for the other harnesses
tool-web disabled: no web_fetch, as no other harness has web tools
DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1: no session telemetry to dsh's OpenTelemetry collector
credentials: none on disk: no .credentials.yaml in the image (checked at build) or the state directory; the headless profile disables dsh's credential store and the anthropic route reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, the per-trial token
